This action intelligently detects when to activate based on your workflow context—whether responding to @claude mentions, issue assignments, or executing automation tasks with explicit prompts. See our Migration Guide for step-by-step instructions on updating your workflows to v1.0. The new version simplifies configuration while maintaining compatibility with most existing setups.

🤖 Interactive Code Assistant: Claude can answer questions about code, architecture, and programming
🔍 Code Review: Analyzes PR changes and suggests improvements
✨ Code Implementation: Can implement simple fixes, refactoring, and even new features
